objective: Extend the one owner-authorized natural-language Minecraft goal into a fixed deterministic approach-and-harvest state machine: discover one allowlisted log within a bounded radius, approach only on verified flat/reachable state, then dig exactly once and report game-state evidence.
non_goals: Do not add Mineflayer pathfinder, collect-block, crafting, equipping, combat, jumping, sprinting, food use, storage, obstacle avoidance, retries, autonomous background play, or model-generated code.
Do not expose individual movement, yaw, coordinate, target-copy, inventory, or skill controls back to the Dashboard, preload, Electron IPC, or HTTP service.
Do not allow viewer chat, widget input, Minecraft chat/sign/book content, OCR, VLM, or arbitrary model output to request actions.
Do not persist raw goal text, model output, block scans, world coordinates, screenshots, or game artifacts after the request completes.
Do not add a new dependency or modify owner-provided files outside this brief.
contracts: The model still returns exact JSON containing one fixed goal ID or null and never returns an action sequence, coordinates, tool calls, code, or hidden reasoning.
The only executable goal identifier is the new versioned approach-and-harvest ID; the retired reach-only goal ID is rejected at every typed boundary.
The deterministic controller owns every state transition: discover, bounded approach, reach verification, single dig, and postcondition verification.
Every approach segment checks fresh physics state and on-ground player state; cancellation, disconnect, and emergency stop clear controls and stop digging before socket release.
oss_candidates: Mineflayer 4.37.1 already pinned in M09; use only documented block lookup, look, control-state and dig APIs behind Hina's existing port.
acceptance_criteria: A natural owner request can choose only the approach-and-harvest goal; the old reach-only goal identifier and malformed model output fail closed before action.
The controller locates at most one normal allowlisted log within a fixed eight-block horizontal radius and rejects vertical/blocked/unreachable targets before dig.
The controller may perform at most three verified movement segments of no more than two blocks on fresh on-ground state, then performs at most one dig attempt.
Success requires both a verified approach state and a reread proving the exact target log is absent; blocked, stale, cancellation and postcondition failures report bounded evidence and never retry.
The Dashboard continues to offer one goal textarea only, accurately explains the bounded flat-ground capability, and exposes no manual gameplay controls.
Disconnect and emergency stop abort an in-flight approach or dig, clear controls, call stopDigging, and leave no action active.
required_test_commands: uv run --frozen python -m unittest discover -s packages/text-brain/tests -p test_minecraft_goals.py
uv run --frozen python -m unittest discover -s apps/core-runtime/tests -p test_minecraft_goal_routes.py

latency_or_quality_budget.goal_planner_model_budget: same local Qwen checkpoint, exact JSON final only, no exposed reasoning
latency_or_quality_budget.approach: at most three movement segments, each at most two blocks, total goal timeout no greater than 18 seconds
latency_or_quality_budget.discovery_radius: eight horizontal blocks; same-level target only
latency_or_quality_budget.retention: in-memory request/result only; no raw inputs, world scans, model plans, or evidence files
